records.q: A disk is 500 GB and fills at 2 GB per hour. It is now 90% full. In how many hou
records.a:
500 GB total.  
90% full means it currently has:

0.90 × 500 = 450 GB used.

Remaining space: 500 - 450 = 50 GB.

Fills at 2 GB per hour.

Time to fill remaining 50 GB = 50 / 2 = 25 hours.

Answer: 25
